note: HGI-1 serial-unit slot (hgi-1010/d, 2026-10-10; coordinator-approved own spine slot): the three record units that were declared on the legacy shared quarter masters (hfd_su / hfd_sfu / hfd_hc: only their SW instance carried the record pins) as one block in the free top end of the spine column.  su = ot_hgi_su_unit (N 16, record adapter + stage / drain controller + ot_hdc_v41x_vec + the banked local memory: G0 A 2^17, G1 B+O 2^16, G2 C+R 2^15, G3 D 2^14, GS STREAM 2^16 words, ot_sram_1r1w_{1024,256,128}x256 macros); sfu = the same unit GLU 1 (SFU.GLU) at 2^14 words a group, no STREAM region; hc = HC.HC_MIX / ROWS / POST (below).  Every record bit and VM packet bit is bound; The SU STREAM output drives hfd_hgi_am's logit stream (hgi_am_s_*, gated by its am_rdy: hgi_am_rdy).  OPEN: the SU STREAM input s0 waits for the SM x-load / pub peers in the VM block; hc = ot_hgi_hc_die: the unit + its HBM weight lane client (ot_hgi_hbm_rd_client -> die nets hgi_hcm_q / hgi_hcm_r -> ot_hgi_hbm_rd_server on kport lane 3 of the loader, XLANE 1), weight windows in macros (WMACRO 1).

su.halted.reason: sticky halt mirror of rec_fault (the fault rides t_hgi_cmdproc_su[2]); observation only

sfu.rec_sut.reason: the SFU.GLU record carries no SU template (unit 3 field set ABCO, hgi_die_dispatch)

sfu.rec_d.reason: SFU.GLU reads A, B, C and writes O only (no D operand)

sfu.rec_r.reason: SFU.GLU has no reduction sink R

sfu.rec_i.reason: SFU.GLU has no index operand I

sfu.s0_v.reason: the GLU unit never takes STREAM (ot_hgi_su_record STREAM_OK = !GLU; NOSTR memory)

sfu.am_stream.reason: the GLU unit never streams to ARGMAX (O = STREAM refused)

open_items: hc eps is the DS hc_eps parameter (HC_EPS, the only model with hyper-connections): move it into the HC weight-set header (sector S0 word 3) with hbm-sim
su STREAM input s0_* (die net from the SM publication peer, lands with the SM x-load / pub peers in the VM block)
